profile_text.body:
SpaceX designs, manufactures and launches rockets and spacecraft, according to its own website. The company was founded in 2002, and it describes its purpose as revolutionizing space technology with the ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. It is a for-profit company headquartered in Hawthorne, California, and its profile lists it as a startup.

The site text does not name individual rockets, spacecraft, or other products, and no products are recorded for the company. Its stated position rests on launch and spacecraft manufacturing rather than on any AI offering described in the available material.

The company's legal exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281. No lawsuits are listed individually, and no MCP servers are recorded.
